import re

def matching_open(text, close_idx):
    depth = 0
    i = close_idx
    while i >= 0:
        if text[i] == ']':
            depth += 1
        elif text[i] == '[':
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i
        i -= 1
    return -1

def in_string(text, idx):
    # crude: odd number of unescaped " before idx on same... whole file quote parity
    # better: scan
    i = 0
    in_s = False
    while i < idx:
        c = text[i]
        if c == '"' and (i == 0 or text[i-1] != '\\'):
            # skip objc strings naively
            in_s = not in_s
        elif c == "'" and not in_s:
            pass
        elif c == '/' and i+1 < len(text) and text[i+1] == '/' and not in_s:
            # line comment - jump to newline
            while i < idx and text[i] != '\n':
                i += 1
            continue
        elif c == '/' and i+1 < len(text) and text[i+1] == '*' and not in_s:
            i += 2
            while i+1 < idx and not (text[i] == '*' and text[i+1] == '/'):
                i += 1
            i += 2
            continue
        i += 1
    return in_s

    text = re.sub(r'\bNSMakeCollectable\s*\(', 'CFBridgingRelease(', text)

    # Peel [recv retain/autorelease] and remove [recv release]
    # Match at selector BEFORE closing bracket: " retain]" / " release]" / " autorelease]"
    sel_re = re.compile(r'(?<!@)\b(retain|release|autorelease)\s*\]')
    while True:
        progressed = False
        for m in sel_re.finditer(text):
            if in_string(text, m.start()):
                continue
            # closing ] of the message
            close = m.end() - 1
            # ensure this ] closes the message send containing the selector
            open_idx = matching_open(text, close)
            if open_idx < 0:
                continue
            kind = m.group(1)
            # Verify selector is the message selector (whitespace before it after receiver)
            # receiver is text[open_idx+1:m.start()]
            recv = text[open_idx+1:m.start()]
            if not recv or recv[-1] in '[]':
                # recv should end with receiver expression; OK if ends with ]
                pass
            # Full span
            start, end = open_idx, close + 1
            if kind in ('retain', 'autorelease'):
                # Replace [recv retain] with (recv) or recv if simple
                recv_stripped = recv.strip()
                replacement = recv_stripped
                # If recv is a lone identifier / property / ivar, fine; if it's a message, it already has brackets
                if not (recv_stripped.startswith('[') and recv_stripped.endswith(']')):
                    # may need parens for complex: "foo bar:baz" isn't valid without being a message
                    # identifiers, dotted, arrows OK
                    if re.search(r'\s', recv_stripped) and not recv_stripped.startswith('('):
                        replacement = f'({recv_stripped})'
                text = text[:start] + replacement + text[end:]
            else:
                # release: remove message; also swallow following ;
                end2 = end
                while end2 < len(text) and text[end2] in ' \t':
                    end2 += 1
                if end2 < len(text) and text[end2] == ';':
                    end2 += 1
                text = text[:start] + text[end2:]
            progressed = True
            break  # restart after each edit
        if not progressed:

    lines = []
    for line in text.splitlines(True):
